Moth-Eidol @VERSION@ (macOS @ARCH@)

HOW TO RUN
  1. Unzip and drag MothEidol.app anywhere you like (for example Applications in your home folder).
  2. Open it. Nothing is installed and no administrator password is needed.
  3. The app lives in the menu bar; closing the window keeps it monitoring. Use the tray menu to quit.

IF macOS SAYS THE APP CANNOT BE OPENED
  The app is not notarized yet. Either right-click MothEidol.app > Open > Open,
  or run once in Terminal:   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /path/to/MothEidol.app

YOUR DATA
  Settings, projects and events are stored in ~/Library/Application Support/MothEidol.
  The app only reads your log files, with the permissions of the macOS user running it.
